recycling_method: Aerobic composting / Anaerobic digestion
preparation_instructions: Remove any plastic stickers or produce tags.
disposal_instructions: Place into compost pile or municipal organic collection bin.
contamination_notes: Stickers and produce labels are non-biodegradable plastic contaminants.

recycling_method: Aerobic composting / Anaerobic digestion
preparation_instructions: Discard non-organic toothpicks or plastic wrapping.
disposal_instructions: Add to wet waste bin or home backyard composter.
contamination_notes: Ensure no non-compostable packaging or stickers are attached.

recycling_method: Aerobic composting / Biogas generation
preparation_instructions: Drain excess liquid if storing indoors.
disposal_instructions: Place in green bin or vermicompost bin.
contamination_notes: Avoid excessive cooking oils or inorganic salts.

recycling_method: Direct soil amendment / Composting
preparation_instructions: Remove paper filter unless certified 100% unbleached compostable.
disposal_instructions: Spread directly onto garden soil or add to compost bin.
contamination_notes: Bleached or synthetic coffee pods must not be mixed.

recycling_method: Municipal industrial composting / Anaerobic digester
preparation_instructions: Scrape leftovers into compostable bag or wet bin.
disposal_instructions: Send to municipal bio-waste facility. Avoid home compost if heavily oiled.
contamination_notes: High fat and dairy attract pests in open home composters.

recycling_method: Mineral soil conditioning / Composting
preparation_instructions: Crush lightly to speed up microbial decomposition.
disposal_instructions: Mix into garden soil or compost heap.
contamination_notes: Egg cartons should be recycled separately as paper.

recycling_method: Municipal windrow composting / Mulching
preparation_instructions: Remove rocks, plastic ties, and metallic wires.
disposal_instructions: Bundle dry branches and place leaves into municipal yard bags.
contamination_notes: Treated wood or plastic plant pots contaminate mulch.

recycling_method: Hydrapulping and paper sheet reformation
preparation_instructions: Remove packaging tape, bubble wrap, and styrofoam; flatten completely.
disposal_instructions: Place flattened boxes cleanly in dry paper recycling bin.
contamination_notes: Heavy tape, styrofoam, or water soaking degrades fiber recovery.

recycling_method: De-inking, pulping, and reprographic paper production
preparation_instructions: Remove metal spiral binders, large metal clips, and plastic sleeves.
disposal_instructions: Place into dedicated dry paper recycling bin.
contamination_notes: Thermal receipts containing BPA should not be mixed with office paper.

material: Mechanical groundwood pulp / Glossy coated paper
recycling_method: Pulping and newsprint / insulation remanufacture
preparation_instructions: Keep completely dry. Discard plastic protective wrapper bags.
disposal_instructions: Place dry stacks directly into paper recycling bin.
contamination_notes: Wet or mildewed paper molds and damages entire sorting batches.

recommended_bin: Black Bin (Landfill / General) or Green Bin (Compost)
recycling_method: Industrial composting if local rules allow; otherwise landfill.
preparation_instructions: Tear off and recycle clean top lid; dispose of greasy bottom in compost/trash.
disposal_instructions: Do not place grease-soaked portions in paper recycling bin.
contamination_notes: Grease oil and melted cheese coat pulp fibers preventing water bonding.

recommended_bin: Black Bin (Landfill) or Specialized Cup Station
recycling_method: Specialized hydrapulping capable of separating plastic PE film.
preparation_instructions: Empty all remaining liquid. Discard lid and sleeve separately.
disposal_instructions: Check for specialized cup collection stations; otherwise general waste.
contamination_notes: Curbside facilities cannot separate the fused plastic lining from fibers.

recycling_method: Repulping into paper bags and cardboard liners
preparation_instructions: Empty completely and ensure no food or oil residue remains.
disposal_instructions: Fold flat and place in blue recycling bin.
contamination_notes: Plastic handles or foil linings must be stripped off.

recommended_bin: Blue Bin (Inside Paper Bag) or Compost
recycling_method: Pulping or compost carbon brown material
preparation_instructions: Collect loose strips into a sealed paper envelope or paper grocery bag.
disposal_instructions: Never loose in curbside bin where pieces jam conveyor belt gears.
contamination_notes: Loose confetti jams optical scanners and disc screens at MRFs.

recycling_method: Mechanical wash, flaking, extrusion, and rPET yarn/bottle pelletizing
preparation_instructions: Empty all liquid, rinse lightly, crush to reduce volume, reattach cap.
disposal_instructions: Deposit clean bottle into blue plastic recycling bin.
contamination_notes: Leftover sugary liquids foster bacteria and degrade recycling batch.

recycling_method: Granulation, detergent wash, compounding, and pipe/bench manufacturing
preparation_instructions: Rinse out milk or detergent residue thoroughly. Reattach cap.
disposal_instructions: Place in rigid curbside recycling bin.
contamination_notes: Food residues spoil and cause foul odors during sorting.

recycling_method: Thermal extrusion into auto parts, crates, and storage bins
preparation_instructions: Scrape off food particles and rinse with water until clean.
disposal_instructions: Place clean container in curbside plastic recycling bin.
contamination_notes: Heavy oily food residue causes rejection at sorting facility.

recycling_method: Mechanical shredding and plastic lumber compounding
preparation_instructions: Ensure bag is completely empty, clean, and dry.
disposal_instructions: Take to participating supermarket drop-off kiosk. Never in curbside bin.
contamination_notes: Film wraps around rotating sorter axles, causing costly facility shutdowns.
reference_source: US EPA Soft Plastics Recycling Guide

recycling_method: Densification / Pyrolysis (only at rare specialized depots)
preparation_instructions: Break down to minimize bin volume.
disposal_instructions: Place into general waste bin unless dedicated EPS depot exists.
contamination_notes: Extremely brittle; breaks into microplastic beads that contaminate MRFs.

recycling_method: Chemical recycling / Waste-to-energy incineration
preparation_instructions: Wipe or shake out crumbs.
disposal_instructions: Dispose into general landfill bin or dedicated TerraCycle collection.
contamination_notes: Fused layers of aluminum and plastic polymer cannot be separated mechanically.

recommended_bin: Specialized Construction Depot or General Waste
recycling_method: Specialized halogen recovery or controlled landfill disposal
preparation_instructions: Separate from other plastics.
disposal_instructions: Never burn or place in standard plastic recycling bin.
contamination_notes: Chlorine content damages conventional mechanical recycling equipment.

recycling_method: High-temperature smelting into pure aluminum ingots (closed-loop)
preparation_instructions: Pour out remaining beverage and rinse with water. Keep shape intact.
disposal_instructions: Place clean can into metal recycling bin.
contamination_notes: Residual liquid or cigarette butts inside can contaminate melt.

recycling_method: Magnetic sorting and electric arc furnace melting into new steel
preparation_instructions: Rinse out soup/vegetable sauce cleanly. Tuck lid inside can.
disposal_instructions: Place clean steel can in blue recycling container.
contamination_notes: Rotting food particles can attract vermin and corrode container.

recycling_method: Secondary aluminum smelting
preparation_instructions: Wipe off all food residue; scrunch foil pieces into a fist-sized ball (>5cm).
disposal_instructions: Place compacted foil ball into blue recycling bin.
contamination_notes: Foil soiled with meat fats/baked crust burns up into useless dross.

recommended_bin: Scrap Metal Facility or Hardware Drop-off
recycling_method: Electric arc furnace refining and remelting
preparation_instructions: Wipe down clean of oils.
disposal_instructions: Drop off at local scrap yard or municipal bulky metal drop-off.
contamination_notes: Sharp edges require proper handling.

recommended_bin: Hazardous Waste Depot or Blue Bin (Only If Completely Empty)
recycling_method: De-pressurization, shredding, and metal recovery
preparation_instructions: Ensure can is 100% discharged and depressurized. Do not puncture or crush.
disposal_instructions: Deposit in empty aerosol collection bin or hazardous waste depot.
contamination_notes: Pressurized propellants cause violent explosions inside compactor trucks.

recycling_method: Crushing into cullet, remelting at 1500°C into identical new bottles
preparation_instructions: Rinse out liquid/sauce residue. Remove non-glass metal caps.
disposal_instructions: Place gently into glass recycling bin.
contamination_notes: Residual solids produce smoke and impurities during furnace melting.

material: Soda-lime container glass with mineral colorants
recycling_method: Color-sorted crushing into cullet and furnace remelting
preparation_instructions: Rinse with clean water. Remove metal crown caps or corks.
disposal_instructions: Sort by color where municipal glass bins provide divided compartments.
contamination_notes: Ceramics and stones have higher melting points and ruin bottle integrity.

recycling_method: Landfill or engineered concrete aggregate
preparation_instructions: Wrap broken shards in newspaper for worker safety before binning.
disposal_instructions: Dispose into general residual waste bin.
contamination_notes: Different melting point and thermal properties create defects in new bottles.

recycling_method: Crushed construction aggregate or clean fill
preparation_instructions: Wrap in thick paper or cardboard to prevent sharp injuries.
disposal_instructions: Place into general waste bin or construction rubble skip.
contamination_notes: A single ceramic shard can ruin an entire metric ton of molten glass batch.

material: Flat architectural glass with reflective silvering
recycling_method: Downcycled as abrasive grit or roadbed fill
preparation_instructions: Transport safely without exposed jagged edges.
disposal_instructions: Take to municipal transfer station or place in general waste.
contamination_notes: Coated chemicals and specialized annealing ruin bottle cullet melts.

material: Printed circuit board, lithium-ion battery, rare earths
recycling_method: Manual disassembly, pyro/hydrometallurgical precious metal recovery
preparation_instructions: Back up data and perform factory reset. Remove SIM and memory cards.
disposal_instructions: Deposit at certified e-waste collection center or electronics retailer.
contamination_notes: Damaged lithium batteries can undergo thermal runaway and ignite.

material: Composite electronic assemblies, copper, gold, plastics
recycling_method: Hazardous component abatement, mechanical shredding, and metallurgy
preparation_instructions: Remove external cables and erase hard drive for data privacy.
disposal_instructions: Deliver to municipal e-waste collection day or certified recycler.
contamination_notes: Contains lead solder, mercury backlights, and brominated flame retardants.

material: Copper wire with PVC/TPE insulation jacket
recycling_method: Cryogenic cable granulator and copper wire recovery
preparation_instructions: Coil neatly and secure with a rubber band or twist tie.
disposal_instructions: Bring to e-waste drop-off bin or scrap metal recycler.
contamination_notes: Cables tangle sorting machinery if thrown in curbside recycling bins.

material: FR4 fiberglass substrate with gold, copper, solder
recycling_method: High-efficiency smelting and precious metal hydrometallurgy
preparation_instructions: Keep dry and intact. Do not break or burn.
disposal_instructions: Deliver to authorized electronic scrap aggregator.
contamination_notes: Burning or acid leaching releases dioxins and heavy toxic fumes.

material: Zinc, manganese dioxide, or lithium cobalt oxide
recycling_method: Shredding, magnetic separation, and hydrometallurgical recovery
preparation_instructions: Tape battery terminals with clear electrical tape to prevent short circuits.
disposal_instructions: Place into dedicated battery collection box at retailers or libraries.
contamination_notes: Punctured or shorted batteries spark uncontrollable fires in trucks.

material: Volatile organic compounds, pigments, synthetic resins
recycling_method: High-temperature hazardous incineration or paint fuel blending
preparation_instructions: Seal lid tightly. If empty and completely dry, steel can be recycled.
disposal_instructions: Transport upright to household hazardous waste collection depot.
contamination_notes: Liquid paint poured down drains contaminates groundwater and sewer pipes.

recycling_method: Triple-rinsing (if directed) and high-temperature incineration
preparation_instructions: Never reuse container. Keep in original labeled bottle.
disposal_instructions: Deliver safely to hazardous chemical collection facility.
contamination_notes: Even minute residual droplets are toxic to wildlife and sorting personnel.

material: Mercury vapor, phosphor powder, glass tube
recommended_bin: Hazardous Waste Depot / Hardware Store Drop-off
recycling_method: Mercury vacuum thermal desorption and phosphor recovery
preparation_instructions: Keep intact; wrap carefully in bubble wrap or cardboard sleeve to prevent breakage.
disposal_instructions: Drop off at participating hardware stores or hazardous collection center.
contamination_notes: Breaking releases invisible toxic mercury vapor into immediate indoor air.

recommended_bin: Red Biohazard Sharps Container / Pharmacy Return
recycling_method: Autoclaving and biohazard medical waste incineration
preparation_instructions: Immediately place used needle directly into puncture-resistant sharps container.
disposal_instructions: Return sealed sharps container to hospital, pharmacy, or clinic.
contamination_notes: Needle-stick injuries expose sanitation workers to bloodborne pathogens.

recommended_bin: Textile Donation Bin or Clothes Drop-off
recycling_method: Re-wear resale or mechanical garnetting into insulation/cleaning rags
preparation_instructions: Launder and dry thoroughly. Fold cleanly.
disposal_instructions: Deposit into charitable clothing bin or store garment recycling program.
contamination_notes: Damp textiles harbor mold and ruin entire batches of donated clothing.

recycling_method: Secondary thrift reuse or chemical depolymerization into new PET yarn
preparation_instructions: Ensure clean and dry. Check pockets and zip closures.
disposal_instructions: Donate to local thrift charity or bring to textile drop-off depot.
contamination_notes: Heavily stained or oil-soaked garments cannot be resold or processed.

material: Vulcanized rubber, EVA foam, leather, synthetic fabric
recommended_bin: Specialized Shoe Recycling Box or Donation
recycling_method: Mechanical grinding into athletic turf, playground mulch, or playground tiles
preparation_instructions: Tie matching shoes together by their laces.
disposal_instructions: Bring to specialized athletic shoe collection program (e.g. Nike Reuse-A-Shoe).
contamination_notes: Heavily damaged or rotting shoes with detached soles go to general waste.

material: Mixed cotton and synthetic fiber scraps
recycling_method: Industrial wipe conversion or soundproofing insulation manufacture
preparation_instructions: Wash clean of toxic chemicals or solvents.
disposal_instructions: Place in textile collection box labeled for scrap/rag recycling.
contamination_notes: Oily automotive rags are spontaneous combustion risks; dispose safely.

material: Superabsorbent sodium polyacrylate and synthetic fleece
recycling_method: Sanitary landfill burial or specialized waste-to-energy incineration
preparation_instructions: Roll soiled diaper tightly, secure with adhesive tabs, and wrap in small bag.
disposal_instructions: Place securely into general residual waste bin. Never in compost or recycling.
contamination_notes: Fecal coliform bacteria and human pathogens contaminate recycling stream.

material: Cellulose acetate plastic filter with nicotine and heavy tar
recommended_bin: Black Bin (Landfill / General Waste) or TerraCycle
recycling_method: Specialized chemical separation of plastics or landfill disposal
preparation_instructions: Ensure completely extinguished and cold before disposal.
disposal_instructions: Drop into public street ashtray or general trash bin. Never litter on ground.
contamination_notes: Filters contain hundreds of toxic chemicals that leach into stormwater.

material: Polymer backing, cellulose fluff, plastic outer sheet
recycling_method: Bio-waste incineration or lined sanitary landfill
preparation_instructions: Wrap tightly in toilet paper or wrapper before disposal.
disposal_instructions: Place into bathroom sanitary bin or general landfill bin.
contamination_notes: Cannot be recycled or flushed; causes sewer blockages and biohazard.

material: Multi-layer plastic, foil, and adhesive laminate
recycling_method: Incineration with energy recovery or sanitary landfill
preparation_instructions: Empty all remaining food particles.
disposal_instructions: Place in general household waste bin.
contamination_notes: Inseparable micro-layers prevent standard mechanical recycling.

material: Inorganic grit, synthetic microfibers, pet hair, dust mites
recycling_method: Sanitary landfill disposal
preparation_instructions: Empty vacuum canister directly into bag; tie tightly to avoid dust dispersal.
disposal_instructions: Dispose into regular black landfill bin.
contamination_notes: Synthetic carpet fibers and heavy metals prevent soil composting.
